listing.title: Note: facts your knowledge base can re-check
listing.summary: Writes one fact per markdown note with the date it was measured and the command that re-measures it, so a vault never goes quietly stale.

compatibility: Any agent that can write files. Works with any folder of markdown notes; a search server for the vault is optional.

replace.from:
With the vault's MCP server that
is `kb_reindex`; otherwise whatever the vault's own indexer is.
replace.to:
With an MCP search server that
is its reindex tool; otherwise whatever the vault's own indexer is.
